summary: First-person consciousness screen made use/mention aware: markers occurring only inside quoted example utterances no longer trip the anti-universe / eval-leakage gates.
cause: ~30 docs quote a hypothetical model utterance ('I am aware of my own processing') precisely to reject self-report as evidence; the naive substring screen misread these as authorial first-person content.
impact: Genuine unquoted first-person claims still fail; 30 benign quoted-example docs retained.
